real_business_check: Per standing practice: searched 'spray foam receptionist' and the exact phrase. No real business operates under this name — results are unrelated job listings (a spray foam company hiring a receptionist), a random Facebook mention, and an unrelated phone-lookup page. Confirmed low collision risk, matches the domain's generic-concept naming pattern. Cleared to proceed.
framing_decision: CRITICAL: 'answering service for contractors' / 'virtual receptionist service' / 'live answering service' carry EXTREMELY HIGH commercial CPC ($100-330+) and are dominated in the real SERP by actual operating answering-service companies with live agents or AI platforms (AnswerPro, AnswerHero, Posh, ReceptionHQ, Smith.ai, MAP Communications, plus newer AI-answering startups: Dapta.ai, Whippy.ai, Bland.ai, Retell AI, Insighto.ai). CCA does not operate a staffed call center or AI answering platform. Building a literal sales page with fake pricing tiers/signup flow for a phone-answering service that doesn't actually exist would be dishonest and could cause real harm (a contractor signs up expecting live phone coverage that was never real). DECISION: build this as an educational resource + consultative lead-gen site — real, useful buyer's-guide content on the missed-call problem specifically for spray foam contractors, with a soft 'get matched / talk to us about your call coverage' CTA rather than a hard product-purchase flow. This mirrors the successful non-insurance-clone pattern already used on subcontractorindemnityagreement.com earlier this session.
